info.title: COHO Public API 1.0
info.description:
**Legacy API (deprecated).** This document describes `/v1.0/public/*` endpoints (also reachable as `/v1/public/*`).

New integrations MUST use **COHO Public API 1.1** (`/v1.1/public/*`). v1.0 is frozen: no new endpoints or contract changes except critical production hotfixes.

**Sunset: 6 October 2026 (UTC).** After this date v1.0 routes will return 404 in production. v1.0 responses include `Deprecation`, `Sunset`, and `Link` (`rel="successor-version"`) headers pointing at the matching v1.1 path where applicable.

### Migrate to v1.1

1. Keep the same `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>` header.
2. Change the path prefix: `/v1/public/...` or `/v1.0/public/...` → `/v1.1/public/...`.
3. For single-item maintenance, viewing, tenancy, rent-due-record, and info-box routes, switch path `{reference}` to `{guid}` from v1.1 list payloads.
4. Watch renamed paths: `rooms/{reference}` → `properties/{propertyReference}/rooms/{roomReference}`; `viewings/createviewing` → `viewings`; `infobox` → `info-boxes`.

Full operation map and notes: [Public API v1.0 → v1.1 migration guide](https://api.coho.life/docs/public-api/v1.0-to-v1.1).

**PATCH:** request bodies are ordinary JSON objects with optional properties (a partial update). They are not RFC 6902 JSON Patch operation arrays. Send `Content-Type: application/json`.
